title: A Theoretical Analysis of Test-Driven Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2602.06098v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Code assistants are increasingly utilized in test-driven software development, yet the theoretical mechanisms behind their environment-interaction strategies remain underexplored. We provide a probabilistic framework for two dominant paradigms: code selection after generation using the execution environment, and code generation conditioned on environment feedback. First, we formalize several well-established selection heuristics as environment-aware estimators of code correctness. We theoretically prove that estimators based on fuzzy functional similarity add an inductive bias and strictly dominate estimators based on functional equivalence in terms of signal-to-noise ratio. Second, we frame backprompting as an in-context approximation of Thompson sampling. We derive a novel regret bound for reward functions with unobservable components, theoretically explaining why the effectiveness of backprompting is limited by the ambiguity

translated_title: 测试驱动代码生成的理论分析
translated_abstract: 代码助手在测试驱动的软件开发中的应用日益广泛，但其环境交互策略背后的理论机制仍然缺乏深入研究。我们为两种主流范式提供了概率框架：利用执行环境在生成后进行代码选择，以及以环境反馈为条件的代码生成。首先，我们将若干成熟的选择启发式方法形式化为环境感知的代码正确性估计器。我们从理论上证明，基于模糊功能相似性的估计器引入了归纳偏置，并且在信噪比方面严格优于基于功能等价性的估计器。其次，我们将回溯提示（backprompting）框架化为汤普森采样的上下文内近似。我们为包含不可观测成分的奖励函数推导出了一个新的遗憾界，从理论上解释了为什么回溯提示的有效性受限于歧义性。
tldr: 本文建立了测试驱动代码生成的概率理论框架，证明了基于模糊功能相似性的代码选择估计器在信噪比上严格优于基于功能等价性的估计器，并将回溯提示形式化为汤普森采样的上下文内近似，推导出新的遗憾界以解释其有效性受限于歧义性的原因。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a probabilistic theoretical framework for test-driven code generation, proving that fuzzy functional similarity estimators strictly dominate functional equivalence estimators in signal-to-noise ratio, and formalizing backprompting as an in-context approximation of Thompson sampling with a novel regret bound explaining its ambiguity-limited effectiveness.
